svg.metadata: {"changes": "Isolate original race-route geometry; omit annotations, pit lanes, alternative routes, sectors, flags, backgrounds and white halo. Black paint, rounded stroke and proportional padded SVG viewport; original path data and transforms are unchanged.", "credit": "GabrielStella, Gpmat and Sentoan", "historicalApplicability": "Source explicitly describes F1 layout, 15 turns. The complete race loop is the union of the 2011-character black path and separate 236-character black F1 Turn1 leg, preserving both original transforms. They overlap on the start/finish straight and approach to Turn2. Omit gray 223-character alternative Turn1 hairpin and other bypasses; matches 4.653 km official 2020/2021 map, not MotoGP alternative.", "license": "CC-BY-SA-4.0", "licenseUrl": "https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/", "page": "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Aut%C3%B3dromo_do_Algarve_F1_Sectors.svg", "sourceSha256": "e58fff9484bd3194a6a93c7afd41db640d5a63ad49d5b86ab4fc3399df457ef2", "url": "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/0a/Aut%C3%B3dromo_do_Algarve_F1_Sectors.svg"}
svg.desc: Authentic source transforms applied; proportionally sampled route with subpixel curve tolerance; uniform black double contour with transparent center and background; no labels.
